majors.name: Iron Paladins
majors.effect: Reinforce gives 8 Supply; Muster gives 8 Manpower. Total yield, one chosen Faction Action.

majors.name: WAAAGH! Bell-Ringa
majors.trait: More Boyz Fer Da Fight — Martial Culture

majors.name: Order of Saint Erigone
majors.effect: +6 Supply each Logistics Cycle; no Manpower bonus.

minors.name: Argive Muster Council
minors.description: The surviving muster authorities dispute Orontes’ right to requisition their armies and stores. They remain Imperial in allegiance but refuse his local command.

minors.name: Eleusinian Synod
minors.description: Independent shrine administrators and militia reject Althaia’s claim to absorb their hospitals and levies. Their dispute concerns jurisdiction, not devotion to Chaos.

minors.name: Calydonian Labour Defence
minors.description: Human defence committees hold the settlements Bell-Ringa has not conquered. They welcome neither the Orks nor demands that would leave their people unprotected.

minors.name: Aulis Anchorage Command
minors.description: Stranded naval officers preserve embarkation infrastructure under emergency orders. They will judge the Paladins by credentials and conduct; cooperation does not transfer ownership.

minors.name: House Atreides
minors.description: The hereditary government claims a mandate to reunify Atreus. Its arsenal and fortified seat make it the prize Minor. It considers both incoming Imperial Major commanders to be exceeding their remit.

minors.name: Delphic Custodians
minors.description: Archive officials and station security restrict access to surviving astropathic records. Contradictory messages support competing claims; no unearned intelligence bonus follows.

minors.name: Lotus Company
minors.description: Human privateers occupy an outlying settlement and live by interception and salvage. Their contracts and warrants do not establish an Imperial alliance.

minors.name: Nemean Estate Compact
minors.description: Landowners and militia defend the agricultural estates and hunting preserves that once provisioned crusades. They require credible protection before accepting new obligations.

minors.name: Lerna Reclamation Directorate
minors.description: Reclamation crews and manufactorum security preserve chemical works and settled islands. Their infrastructure is mutually dependent, but their authority remains local.

minors.name: Rustjaw Mob
minors.description: A separate Ork mob holds a captured industrial outpost. It shares Ork alignment with Bell-Ringa but has not submitted to his command or granted use of its forces.

minors.name: Ithacan Assembly
minors.description: Settlement delegates and veterans govern displaced families. They value dependable protection over grand claims and may cooperate with the Paladins without endorsing their enemies’ accusations.

minors.name: Thessalian First Command
minors.description: Officers of the senior surviving regimental headquarters claim authority over the vehicle depots and military estates.

minors.name: Thessalian Remount Command
minors.description: A rival commission protects dispersed remount settlements. Its officers dispute the First Command’s seniority; neither is automatically subordinate to a Major.

holdings.name: Tiryns
holdings.description: Fortified industrial Capital and fortress-monastery of the Iron Paladins.

holdings.name: Heraion
holdings.description: Former army assembly world with storehouses and an entrenched military administration.

holdings.name: Prosymna
holdings.description: Service settlements whose levies support the Council’s larger holding.

holdings.name: Erigone
holdings.description: Shrine Capital centred on the convent and memorials of the Order’s campaign saint.

holdings.name: Triptolemos
holdings.description: Pilgrim reception world, granaries and hospital communities.

holdings.name: Daeira
holdings.description: A secluded shrine settlement guarding the Synod’s archives.

holdings.name: Da Bellworks
holdings.description: Captured foundry Capital; former Imperial name Chalkeia. Its furnaces cast machinery and cathedral bells.

holdings.name: Pleuron
holdings.description: Industrial estates still held by human militia and surviving regular troops.

holdings.name: Olenos
holdings.description: Polluted agricultural settlements supplying the remaining human enclaves.

holdings.name: Perseia

holdings.name: Dendra

holdings.name: Lion Gate
